answer_1.quote: We introduce LVAS-Agent, a multi-agent collaborative framework for end-to-end long video audio synthesis. Built on VLM and LLM-based agents, it simulates real-world dubbing workflows, enabling automatic video script generation, audio design, and high-quality audio synthesis for long videos.
answer_1.outputs: structured video scripts, audio design documents, and synthesized sound effects for long videos

answer_2.quote: We assess the generation quality in four different dimensions: distribution matching, audio quality, semantic alignment, and temporal alignment.

answer_4.quote: We conducted a user study involving 30 participants to evaluate our method in comparison with FoleyCrafter and MMAudio. Participants were asked to listen to 10 audio samples generated by each method and rate them on a scale of 1 to 5 across three dimensions: "Audio Quality," "Video-Audio Consistency," and "Overall Satisfaction."
